purpose: Label-independent, auditable mechanism weights for safe region-lifted BO. No candidate yield or global optimum was used.

rationale: Oxidative addition is favored by a more activated leaving group and an electron-rich ligand.
Transmetalation benefits from transferable organoboron partners and an effective base.
Strongly coordinating components receive a conservative penalty because they may inhibit palladium turnover.
sources: Mechanistic Suzuki coupling roles encoded in the repository's pre-existing label-independent descriptor schema.

rationale: Electron-rich bulky monophosphines promote oxidative addition and productive reductive elimination.
A strong, weakly coordinating base supports amine deprotonation without strongly binding palladium.
Heteroaryl and additive coordination are treated as risks, while the online alignment gate can reject this coarse prior.
sources: Wiley Angewandte Chemie 2019 review cited in buchwald_literature_knowledge_cards.json
